fact: Cairngorm Cavern is a massive underground home located in the Southfurrow District.
source_quote: The party made their way to the Cairngorm Cavern, a massive and imposing underground home carved deep into the Southfurrow District

fact: Clan Cairngorm is a group of Stone Giants dwelling in the Cairngorm Cavern.
source_quote: where the Stone Giants of Clan Cairngorm dwelled

fact: Hgraam sits at the entrance of the cavern waiting for the party.

fact: Hgraam stands up when the party arrives.

subject: Hgraam stands
